plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Japanese map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the first/default pathway, 'Japanese to CSU', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map with no second-institution section. The program's other pathway, 'Japanese to Degree' (also printed at 60-62.5 units, 4 terms), is the same AA credential with a degree (non-CSU-transfer) pattern, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-62.5 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15 / 15 / 15-16. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5) and Term 4 'Major List A' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. JAPN B2 is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; it is a named major course and is recorded with category 'major'. JAPN B2, JAPN B3 and JAPN B4 each show a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded and the flags are disclosed on those course rows. No other row shows a flag. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Term 3 prints two separate 'CSU Transferable Elective' rows (3 units and 1 unit); both are recorded as separate choice slots exactly as printed. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
